claim: The vendor-document acts that write money refuse a token that does not hold the house's money (fix/document-money-writes-for-holders). In apps/api-gateway/src/procurement/documents/documents.controller.ts, the eleven handlers mintFieldCorrectSeal, correctField, mintFieldVerifySeal, verifyFieldTick, applyExtraction, match, linkLine, mintLineEditSeal, editLine, mintVerifySeal and verify each call assertHoldsHouseMoney(user, <act>) before any seal is minted, redeemed or path-checked and before any intake, corrections, canonical, mapping or database call. The door stays open: linkLineToItem, doorCount and upload carry no such call. document-money-gate.ts decides a holder by policyFor(role).sees.includes("money") (ADR 0145's ROLE_POLICY), so owner, manager and admin pass and staff, an unknown role and no role are refused. Reads (GET /, GET :id, GET :id/canonical) are not covered by this claim.

claim: POST /procurement/documents still stores every signed-in person's paper, but a session that does not hold the house's money gets the parse cut to an allowlist and amountsWithheld: true at the root (fix/document-money-writes-for-holders). The upload handler computes holder = holdsHouseMoney(user.role ...) and returns document: holder ? result.parsed : doorEchoOf(result.parsed); doorEchoOf returns null or the picked doc and nothing else, and picks only DOOR_ECHO_DOCUMENT_KEYS = docType, docNumber, lines and, per line, DOOR_ECHO_LINE_KEYS = lineNo, qty, uom, packSize, qtyBottles (what apps/web DoorModel.readPaper reads). The verify pins both lists exactly, so adding any key, money or not, turns it red until someone re-reads this claim.

claim: DocumentIntakeService.link() (apps/api-gateway/src/procurement/documents/document-intake.service.ts) refuses an orderId that is not this house's order: before it inserts into procurement_document_links it reads procurement_orders filtered by .eq("restaurant_id", ...). Open: link() inserts the orderId it is given unchecked, and the upload hands it the caller's body.orderId (ingest -> linkAndMatch -> link(..., "manual", 1)). Found by the ADR 0090 audit of PR #659 at 8b5849388; predates that branch. Covers the ownership half only; whether a staff upload should pair at all is an open fork with no row (see tech-debt.d/2026-10-07-fix-document-money-writes-for-holders.md, 'The upload still pairs'). The verify exits 126 (could not run) if link() or its procurement_document_links insert can no longer be found, so a rename cannot keep this row quietly open.
